fact_transactions partitions are ROLLING-WINDOW daily exports: 537,278 raw rows across 64 partitions dedupe to 59,114 distinct TransactionID (~9x). A union-without-dedup ledger would inflate every flow number; keep-last-partition dedup carries restatement semantics (_partition_date = the surviving export).

The vendor ships its OWN external-flow designation (`External Flow` enum {None, Contribution, Withdrawal}) -- neither sibling firm has one. Carried as a corroboration axis. HEADLINE DISAGREEMENT: BD marks ALL 594 Management Fee rows external-Withdrawal where GIPS classes them FEE-MANAGEMENT (never external) -- a vendor-NNA-vs-GIPS methodology divergence, adjudicated at C_00 with provenance, and an NNA-definition ruling candidate. Also: 202 of 11,599 Buy rows marked Contribution, 9 Sale rows + 57 Tax Withholding rows + 86 Expense rows marked Withdrawal.
Full-series type census = 16 types / 28 pairs; the COT spec's 14x21 were window-sample counts (the spec's own prior-3 warning, confirmed by measurement).

UNRESOLVED = the Corporate Action family (5 sub-types, 64 rows, $3.34M abs) + Return of Capital (1 row) -- exactly the INF five-code-amendment class. Taxonomy amendment is a ruling-class act: surfaced to COO, never guessed. Cross-check: corporate-action rows carry amount_sum $0.00 (Merger/Spinoff/Splits) consistent with non-cashflow reclassification events.

Collection detection ABSENT-with-shape is now MEASURED (the COT spec had it unverified): 0 of 618 Management Fee rows are non-rebate payee-side credits across the full series; the 24 positive rows are all Rebate sub-type (fee reversals into client accounts, max specimen class identical to INF's $0.17 lesson).
One Cash Withdrawal row carries a ZERO amount (not positive -- the sign census's 1149/1150 residual named exactly).

The classification key must be the (type, sub_type) PAIR: Buy x Dividend Reinvestment (DRIP leg), Management Fee x Rebate (fee reversal), Expense x Tax Withholding (withholding) all cross type boundaries with different semantics -- a type-only rule list would misclass all three.
No forced path constant exists in the family: the writer REFUSES an empty output root -- F-1 remains fully undecided by this build.
